pages.title: Play and odds
pages.text: Each reel draws independently: cherry 25%, lemon 25%, orange 20%, bell 15%, star 10%, diamond 5%.$(br2)Any matching pair pays ×1.2. Triples use the higher triple prize; prizes do not stack.

pages.title: Winning combinations
pages.text: Triples:$(br)Cherry ×3; lemon ×4; orange ×7$(br)Bell ×16; star ×40; diamond ×200$(br2)Total winning chance: 51.25%. Triple diamonds: 0.0125% (1/8,000). Spins are independent.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Default Lv.5; initial stake cap 200,000. Wallet upgrades can raise it.$(br2)The result settles automatically once.$(br2)Payouts include the stake. Server rules may differ; check the live interface.
Craft, then right-click to use. Machines still require the matching wallet level.
